summary:
The galaxy draws about 45 ship and station kinds. galaxy/models.js:30-96 lists them in MODELS. They come from four places. (1) Sketchfab GLBs, mostly Daniel Andersson's: 7-48k triangles, often with no textures or only 512 px maps (tie, awing, ywing, bwing, shuttle, gunboat; the interdictor has one 9 KB map). (2) 14 Meshy 'library' ships from scripts/meshy-galaxy-library.mjs: about 15-16k triangles, three 1024 webp maps, 650-1050 KB each. (3) Two gen3d models wired in through MADE (models.js:101): the x-wing and the tie-interceptor, in device cuts. The .hq cut is 120k triangles, 4096 maps and 3.3 MB. (4) Two HQ capitals for high/ultra detail (models.js:113-122). Kinds without a GLB are built in code: skiff, cloudcity, gate, and every stand-in. Every GLB is meshopt + webp (inspect.jsonl in my scratchpad has triangles and textures per file).

I rendered about 50 models in 4 views each (scripts/glb-shot.mjs, dev server on 5193) and took in-game shots at Endor. Worst first:
- **Second Death Star** (galaxy/deathstar2.glb): 5,432 triangles and one 512 map. The unfinished half is a stack of flat grey discs, and up close the texture is a blur. It is 140 units across and you fly up to it, so this is the worst thing on screen. The code-built version (fleetRebels.js:497, 16.6k triangles, with a superstructure lattice) looks better, but it only shows until the GLB loads.
- **Interdictor**: a flat white wedge (40k triangles, one 9 KB texture). It is in every GCW Imperial line and is the objective in interdiction battles.
- **CR90 corvette** (universe/cr90.glb): 256 px maps that look like a blotchy scan. It is the most common Rebel escort (battle weight 75), and scene.js:406 loads it on every arrival.
- **Munificent**: the shape is right, but the paint is muddy green and brown camouflage instead of pale grey with blue stripes. It is the most common Separatist capital (weight 51).
- **Providence**: dark and muddy, 9.7k triangles.
- **gen3d TIE interceptor**: lumpy frames, a crumpled cockpit ball, chrome blotches (weight 49, plus Empire and remnant hunters).
- **Slave I** (universe/slave1.glb): blobby scan, one 512 map.

Two wiring bugs make it worse, and neither needs credits:
- Galaxy hunters and wingmen fly the Y-wing, A-wing and TIE bomber as their 1.5k-triangle far-off copies (lod/*.glb). These have no normals, so they render faceted (glbFleet.js:44-46, inherited by HUNTER_GLB at models.js:176-183).
- The bounty hunters (IG-2000, Hound's Tooth, Punishing One) and the navy's gunboat fly code-built ships, even though their GLBs exist in MODELS.

Fighters that look fine: x-wing (gen3d), arc170, vulture, trifighter, delta7, uwing, ig2000. Capitals that look fine: freighter, transport, hammerhead, venator, acclamator, lucrehulk, nebulon, hq destroyer. The player ships look good: xwing-hd 134k triangles, falcon-hd 61k, rv-wings 13k; the Rick and Morty cruiser is a toon-shaded Meshy figure (rickmorty/cruiser3d.js).

**The 14 gen3d ships the handoff approved:** public/models/gen3d/ still holds only x-wing, tie-fighter and tie-interceptor. The tie-fighter is not wired anywhere outside the eval scripts, and its wings render as a messy web of struts, so it is worse than galaxy/tie.glb. Since the handoff:
- YT-2400 (freighter), GR-75 (transport), Xg-1 (gunboat) and IG-2000 came from Sketchfab.
- Hound's Tooth and Punishing One came from Meshy.
- Z-95, stock YT-1300, HWK-290, Kimogila and the Flarestar pirate fighter were never made. Only the pirates' code-built 'skiff' (1.4k triangles) would use one of them.
- TIE bomber, TIE Advanced and Slave I were never remade.

**Download budget:** measured GLB bytes on arrival are 9.6 MB at Tatooine on high, 14.5 MB at Endor on high and 10.9 MB at Endor on mid, so /galaxy is already over its 8 MB budget. 6.6 MB of that is the gen3d .hq x-wing and interceptor that scene.js:406 loads on every arrival.

**Meshy:** the proven flow is a Wookieepedia picture lifted onto grey (image-to-image), then image-to-3d or multi-image-to-3d, then the fetch/squeeze step into public/models/galaxy/<kind>.glb, then the far-off copy (galaxy-lod.mjs), then credits (public/games/credits.json 'meshy/<kind>' plus public/cc0/README.md:30). It produced decent library ships (gauntlet, twilight, tiedefender, hammerhead). Current prices from docs.meshy.ai/en/api/pricing: image-to-3d or multi-image 30 credits with 2K or 4K textures (35 with 8K); image-to-image 3 (nano-banana), 6 (nano-banana-2) or 9 (nano-banana-pro); remesh 5; retexture 10. Account 3's balance is 2,368, not 2,786: another session is spending it on Rick and Morty assets today. About 450 credits makes the 13-model plan below on first tries; reserve about 770 to cover retries.

rootCauses.title: The second Death Star's GLB is a 5.4k-triangle sphere with one 512 map; the half-built side is stacked flat discs
rootCauses.mechanism: MODELS.deathstar2 (models.js:71) loads Sketchfab 'Death Star 2 (Remake)' (modelCredits.json 'galaxy-deathstar2'), imported at tris 12000 / tex 2048 (sketchfab-galaxy.mjs:99), but it came out 5,432 triangles with a single 512x512 33 KB webp. world.js:351 shows it at size 140 (systems.js:257). The camera can get within a few units, so the 512 map smears and the unfinished section reads as grey plates. The better code-built version (fleetRebels.js:497, 16.6k triangles with a lattice) only shows until the GLB arrives.
rootCauses.evidence: inspect: deathstar2.glb 79 KB, 5432 tris, webp 512x512. Renders: scratchpad/models/shots/galaxy_deathstar2.jpg (stacked discs) vs shots/built_deathstar2.png (lattice, full hull). In game: ingame/ingame-endor-high-deathstar2.png (blurred band and flat disc edges) and ingame-endor-high-executor.png (flat faceted top). systems.js:1180-1182 still says it loads nothing (stale).

rootCauses.title: Galaxy hunters and wingmen fly the Y-wing, A-wing and TIE bomber as 1.5k-triangle flat-shaded far-off copies
rootCauses.mechanism: HUNTER_GLB spreads GLB first (models.js:177). GLB's ywing/awing/tiebomber are the lod/ cuts meant for the universe map (glbFleet.js:42-46). Only vulture, trifighter, tie, tieadvanced, arc170, delta7, moncal and venator are overridden with full models (models.js:178-181). The LOD files have POSITION+COLOR_0 only, so three.js forces flat shading for a MeshStandardMaterial with no normals (three WebGLPrograms.js:319-323), and glbFleet does not compute normals. Hunters (universe/hunters.js:76), wingmen (wingmen.js:39), set pieces and pilots all go through this fleet (scene.js:242-264, 351).
rootCauses.evidence: attrs: lod/ywing.glb 1497 tris POSITION,COLOR_0; lod/awing 1496; lod/tiebomber 1493. Renders: scratchpad/models/lods.jpg (faceted close-ups), against shots/galaxy_ywing.jpg and galaxy_awing.jpg (the 14k-triangle full models).

rootCauses.title: The bounty hunters' ships and the navy gunboat fly code-built in the galaxy although their GLBs exist
rootCauses.mechanism: createFleet.has() returns true for a kind missing from its glb table, and make() then builds it (glbFleet.js:113-118 area; build = buildGalaxyShip → buildTraffic → fleetStarwars.js:1351). HUNTER_GLB has no gunboat, ig2000, houndstooth, punishingone or skiff, even though MODELS has GLBs for the first four (models.js:66-81). So IG-88, Bossk and Dengar (sides.js:45-47) and the navy's gunboats (sides.js:43) appear as primitive stand-ins.
rootCauses.evidence: models.js:176-183 vs MODELS keys; hunted.js:31-36 maps navy/fett/ig88/bossk/dengar/weequay to the universe factions; the Meshy houndstooth/punishingone and Sketchfab ig2000/gunboat renders (shots/galaxy_houndstooth.jpg, galaxy_ig2000.jpg, galaxy_gunboat.jpg) are what should appear.

rootCauses.title: Several capital ships have poor textures: flat white, low-resolution, or the wrong colours
rootCauses.mechanism: Interdictor: a Sketchfab model with one 9 KB 512 map renders flat white. CR90: 256 px maps baked from a scan read as grey-white blotches. Munificent: the A308 Digital model's tiled paint came through as muddy green and brown camouflage; the reference CISMunificent-TCW.png is pale grey and white with blue stripes. Providence: dark, streaky, 9.7k triangles. tune() (models.js:187-199) only clamps roughness and boosts emissive, so it cannot fix any of these.
rootCauses.evidence: inspect: interdictor 40000 tris, one webp 512 9K; cr90 12120 tris, webp 256x256; munificent 24954 tris, 18 maps 512-1024; providence 9709 tris. Renders: shots/galaxy_interdictor.jpg, universe_cr90.jpg, galaxy_munificent.jpg, galaxy_providence.jpg; references refs/munificent.jpg #20, refs/providence.jpg #30/#37.

rootCauses.title: The gen3d TIE interceptor is lumpy and costs 3.3 MB on desktops
rootCauses.mechanism: MADE.interceptor (models.js:101-102) swaps in gen3dUrl('tie-interceptor'), which is the 120k-triangle, 4096-map .hq cut on high/ultra (lib/three/gen3d.js CUTS). The Hunyuan-style bake shows wavy frame edges and a crumpled ball. scene.js:406 loads it, and the 3.25 MB x-wing.hq, on every system arrival.
rootCauses.evidence: shots/gen3d_tie-interceptor.jpg; in-game GLB log for Tatooine at high: tie-interceptor.hq 3348 KB + x-wing.hq 3254 KB out of 9.59 MB total.

rootCauses.title: /galaxy already exceeds its 8 MB model budget on arrival
rootCauses.mechanism: The arrival always loads the destroyer (hq 722 KB on high), corvette, gen3d xwing and interceptor (.hq on high), the player's xwing-hd (1.86 MB) and the system's own kinds. Battles at Endor add about 4 MB of capitals.
rootCauses.evidence: scratchpad/models/ingame.mjs measurements: tatooine high glbMB 9.59; endor high 14.51; endor mid 10.85 (per-URL list in the run output: gen3d .hq 6.6 MB, xwing-hd 1.86 MB, executor 955 KB, hammerhead 1027 KB, hq nebulon 809 KB).

rootCauses.title: Fitting by the biggest side shrinks ships whose wingspan or height beats their length
rootCauses.mechanism: normalise() (models.js:208) and glbFleet (:80) scale so max(x,y,z) = size, but battles.js SIZE treats size as length (53 m per unit, battles.js:7-9, 33-51). Ships wider or taller than they are long come out short: Slave I is 0.51 of its intended length, the ARC-170 0.62, the YT-2400 0.63, the B-wing 0.38, the Falcon 0.79, the TIE bomber 0.83 and the TIE 0.87. This is part of the 'scaling' complaint in HANDOFF-galaxy-roam.md:26.

proposals.title: Zero-credit wiring fixes first: point the galaxy hunters and wingmen at the real models
proposals.description: In models.js HUNTER_GLB (:176-183), add full-model entries for 'ywing', 'awing' and 'tiebomber' ({ ...MODELS[k], built: true }) so the galaxy fleet stops flying the lod/ cuts that GLB (glbFleet.js:42-46) gives the universe map. Add 'gunboat', 'ig2000', 'houndstooth' and 'punishingone' ({ ...MODELS[k], built: true }; their built stand-ins exist in fleetStarwars.js:1351) so IG-88, Bossk, Dengar and the navy's gunboats fly their GLBs. Optionally set 'destroyer' to MODELS.destroyer, so the Star Destroyer set piece uses the HQ cut on high detail like the battles do. Nothing new is downloaded until those hunters appear.
proposals.tests: models.test.js: for k in ['ywing','awing','tiebomber','gunboat','ig2000','houndstooth','punishingone'] expect HUNTER_GLB[k] toEqual { ...MODELS[k], built: true } and expect HUNTER_GLB[k].url not to match /\/lod\//; existing 'are each in the site' still passes.

proposals.title: Second Death Star: remake with Meshy from two stills, gated against the code-built one
proposals.description:
Today: galaxy/deathstar2.glb is 5,432 triangles with one 512 map (evidence shots/galaxy_deathstar2.jpg, ingame/ingame-endor-high-deathstar2.png). Its own fallback, fleetRebels.js:497, renders better (shots/built_deathstar2.png). If the gate below fails, just delete MODELS.deathstar2 (models.js:71) and the built one stays.
Approach: library-lane entry deathstar2 in meshy-galaxy-library.mjs with ref ['File:DeathStar2.jpg' (1040x1040, the classic three-quarter view with the dish and the exposed half), 'File:Death star 2 blueprints sw card trader.png' (1080x795 side schematic)], lifting 'the half-built spherical battle station, its exposed skeletal superstructure on one side, its superlaser dish'. Use nano-banana-pro for the lift (9 credits each). Run multi-image-to-3d with texture_resolution '4k' (same 30 credits) and target_polycount 60000.
Squeeze to 40k triangles: base colour 2048, normal 1024, metal-rough 512, about 1.3 MB. Only Endor loads it.
Wiring: same path, nose 0 (apply a yaw in squeeze, not a nose change). Regenerate lod/deathstar2.glb with galaxy-lod.mjs (4000 triangles, under 120 KB). world.js solids assume a sphere filling 0.47 of the box (world.js:77, :361), so check the bounding box is cubic. Remove 'galaxy-deathstar2' from src/data/modelCredits.json, add 'meshy/deathstar2' to public/games/credits.json and to public/cc0/README.md:30, and fix the stale comment at systems.js:1180-1182.
Gate: render the sheet step (model next to the lift next to the built version) and an in-game Endor close-up. Keep whichever reads better.
Credits: 48, reserve about 100.
proposals.tests: models.test.js stays green (url exists, LOD under 120 KB with 1 primitive). New assertion: the deathstar2 GLB is at least 20k triangles with base colour at least 2048 (read the JSON chunk as primitives() does at models.test.js:12-16), or MODELS.deathstar2 is undefined and 'deathstar2' is in GALAXY_KINDS.

proposals.title: Interdictor: Meshy remake (or show the built one meanwhile)
proposals.description:

The code-built one (shots/built_interdictor.png, glowing gravity-well domes) reads better. Stopgap at zero credits: delete MODELS.interdictor.
Meshy: library entry interdictor with ref 'File:Immobilizer Interdictor Cruiser.jpg' (1200x636, three-quarter view on a red nebula, so it needs the lift), lift text 'the wedge-shaped warship with four large domed gravity-well projectors on its back and a stepped bridge tower'. Model at 4k (30 credits), target 40000.
Squeeze to 25k triangles: base 2048, normal 1024, MR 512, about 900 KB. Keep the same path and nose 0; regenerate the LOD.
Credits: swap 'galaxy-interdictor' in modelCredits.json for 'meshy/interdictor'.
Credits: 33-39, reserve 60.
proposals.tests: models.test.js url and LOD checks; modelCredits.test.js passes once the Sketchfab entry is removed.

proposals.title: CR90 corvette (Tantive IV): Meshy remake as a galaxy-only file
proposals.description:
Today: universe/cr90.glb, 12k triangles with 256 px maps and blotchy scan-like paint (shots/universe_cr90.jpg). It has battle weight 75, is the blockade runner, is the Tantive IV at Scarif, and scene.js:406 loads it on every arrival, so it must stay small.
Meshy: refs 'File:Rebels-TantiveIVConceptArt-CroppedBackground.png' (1830x879, three-quarter on black) and 'File:CR90corvette-BTMF18.png' (2425x940 side). Use nano-banana for 3 credits each, then multi-image-to-3d at 30.
Target: 15k triangles; base 1024, normal and MR 512 using meshy-war's split squeeze (meshy-war.mjs:123-142); at most 450 KB.
Path: public/models/galaxy/corvette.glb, with MODELS.corvette = { url: '/models/galaxy/corvette.glb', nose } placed after the GLB spread, and HUNTER_GLB.corvette pointed at it. The universe map keeps cr90.glb.

proposals.title: TIE interceptor: Meshy remake at a fighter budget, replacing the 3.3 MB gen3d cut in the galaxy
proposals.description:

proposals.title: Pirate fighter for the Weequay skiffs and the Hutts' battles (new kind GLB)

proposals.title: Budget: bring galaxy arrivals back toward 8 MB
proposals.description:
Measured GLB on arrival: Tatooine high 9.59 MB, Endor high 14.51 MB, Endor mid 10.85 MB.
(a) For galaxy AI fighters, load the gen3d '.lo' cut (20k triangles, 1024 maps, 650-750 KB) whatever the device: gen3dUrl(name, 'low') in the MADE loop (models.js:102), and the same in HUNTER_GLB for xwing and redleader. In battles the full model only shows within LOD_NEAR × size, about 13.5 units. This saves about 5.2 MB on high and about 1.9 MB on mid; proposal 5 removes the interceptor half of it.
(b) Squeeze every new Meshy model with meshy-war's split (base at tex, normal and MR at tex/2: meshy-war.mjs:123-142) instead of the library squeeze's one size for every map (meshy-galaxy-buildings.mjs fetch → squeeze). The library ships are 650-1050 KB because all three maps are 1024.
(c) Per-kind caps: fighter at most 450 KB, capital at most 900 KB, DS2 at most 1.4 MB. Only arrival-wanted kinds (scene.js:406: destroyer, corvette, xwing, interceptor) count toward first load; the rest load per system or battle, through kindsIn at jump time (scene.js:1116) and battleScene.js:177.
proposals.tests: models.test.js: MODELS.xwing.url ends with '.lo.glb' (or matches the chosen cut); a budget test summing statSync of the arrival kinds' urls (destroyer, corvette, xwing, interceptor, plus lodUrl of each) stays under about 3 MB for mid detail.

proposals.title: Scaling: fit ships by length, not by their biggest side
proposals.description: normalise() (models.js:201-217, :208) and glbFleet (:80) set max(x,y,z) = size, while sizes are lengths (battles.js:7-9). Add an optional per-kind fit, e.g. MODELS[kind].fit = 'length' or a default of z-length for ships (excluding stations and the deathstar). That corrects Slave I (0.51 of its length today), the ARC-170 (0.62), the YT-2400 (0.63), the B-wing (0.38), the Falcon (0.79), the TIE bomber (0.83) and the TIE (0.87). Check hunter hit radii (KINDS.size) and the LOD fit (fitLike uses the same k), which both scale with it.
proposals.tests: models.test.js: with a fake loader returning a 4x1x2 box (wide) and fit 'length', the slot's z extent equals size; the LOD still matches the full model's box (existing 'puts the LOD where the model is' test).

Meshy keys: the scripts read MESHY_API_KEY, so run them with MESHY_API_KEY="$MESHY_API_KEY_ACC_3" and never print it. Balance at 2026-10-07 ~16:20 UTC was 2368 credits, not about 2786. Meshy prices (docs.meshy.ai/en/api/pricing, 2026-10): image-to-3d and multi-image-to-3d cost 30 with 2K or 4K textures and 35 with 8K. So request texture_resolution '4k' at no extra cost and downsample in squeeze. image-to-image costs 3 (nano-banana), 6 (nano-banana-2) or 9 (nano-banana-pro); remesh 5; retexture 10. A refused task costs nothing. Generation takes about 2-3 minutes per model.

Proven flow (scripts/meshy-galaxy-buildings.mjs with MESHY_TASKS=scripts/meshy-galaxy-library-tasks.json): lift → models → fetch → sheet. The tasks file keeps ids so a step never pays twice. Reference pictures stay in lab/refs (git-ignored) and are never shipped. Library prompts never name the films.

models.test.js pins the url and nose for tie, tiebomber, tieadvanced, shuttle, lightcruiser, gozanti, munificent, providence, nubian and ghost (:42-49). A remade one must keep '/models/galaxy/<kind>.glb' and that nose (rotate in squeeze), or the test changes with it.

Every MODELS kind except deathstar needs lod/<kind>.glb with 1 primitive and under 120 KB (models.test.js:168-180). galaxy-lod.mjs finds kinds by the regex /^\s+(\w+): \{ url: '([^']+\.glb)'/ and prefers glbFleet.js's url (:40), so write MODELS entries on one line with a literal url, and give GLB-kind overrides (corvette, interceptor, slave1) an explicit path.

Replacing a Sketchfab file means removing its src/data/modelCredits.json entry, because modelCredits.test.js checks each entry's file and usage. Meshy outputs are credited in public/games/credits.json ('meshy/<kind>': source https://www.meshy.ai, id = model task id, authors 'Tilak Patel, with Meshy AI', license 'Meshy paid-plan output, owned by the site owner') and listed in public/cc0/README.md:30.

A kind in MODELS with no built version needs a STAND_IN that is built (models.test.js:72-78). Kinds already in BUILT_KINDS or GALAXY_KINDS (deathstar2, interdictor, munificent, skiff, corvette, interceptor…) need none.

Battles' capitals and fighters use MODELS through battleScene.js:77/177. Hunters, wingmen, set pieces and pilots use HUNTER_GLB through the shared fleet (scene.js:242). A new model must be wired in both places to show everywhere. The universe map's wars also use createModels from galaxy/models.js (universe/scene.js:130).
